_note: Written by scripts/art/ui/talk_window.mjs --pieces: do not edit by hand. The talk window (D23, D126 to D128), in the shop window's family, in the window's pixels, 1152 x 648; "at" is a top left corner, and a piece's "at" already counts its shadow. Draw in the order of "order"; text last. Text is drawn by Godot: "at" is the top left of the line (the top is the font's ascent line), "right" its top right, "centre" its top middle. Every place and size here is a setting. The conversation's choices are not decided: every name, line and reply in the draft is made up. The window is one block on the right of the screen: in another window size it would keep to the right (not done).

face._note: The speaker's face: their character's head and shoulders (S side), twice the size, cut to a circle of "radius" round "centre" (the shop's way).

rule._note: Drawn twice: once at each y in "ys" (the piece is drawn for the first).

replies._note: One reply per row, the first row's top at "first_y", "step" down to the next; a click on the row or its number key (1 to 9) picks it. The pointed one: Choice Lit and Badge Lit, its words and number in "on". Badge and Choice Lit are drawn for the first row: move them down by the row's top minus "first_y". For a list of people (D127, D128), how you know each one, right-aligned at "kind".

name._note: Their name if you were told it (D31), else what you see of them (D128).

about._note: Their work and town, as far as you know them.

earlier._note: The last exchange, dim: "who:" then the line, "gap" after it; one line each, "step" apart.

says._note: What they say now, wrapped to "width", "step" apart.

hint.text: Click a reply, or press its number
